task_goal: Land the lander on the landing pad at (0,0) as fast as possible with minimal fuel consumption.
reward_function_interface: def compute_reward(state, m_power, s_power, terminated) -> (float, dict)
state_space: 8-dimensional vector: [x, y, vx, vy, angle, angular_velocity, leg1_contact, leg2_contact]
action_space: Discrete: 0 (do nothing), 1 (fire left orientation engine), 2 (fire main engine), 3 (fire right orientation engine)
success_like_ending: Both legs ground contact (state[6]==1 and state[7]==1).
Lander position near (0,0) with low velocities.
Episode termination without crash or out-of-bounds.
behavior_trajectory_prior: Phase 1: Stabilize and approach the pad from above (control angle and lateral drift).
Phase 2: Descend toward pad with controlled vertical speed, maintaining upright orientation.
Phase 3: Soft touchdown with both legs contacting the pad, minimal residual velocity.
reward_design_risks: Hovering indefinitely at high altitude (avoids crash but never lands).
Landing outside pad but with legs down (no crash but not on pad).
Excessive use of orientation engines causing fuel waste without progress.
Landing with high vertical velocity but legs contact (crash-like but not detected as crash).
